mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) above a 5% MoM growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% MoM, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < -0.2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 3% YoY and consumer spending (RSAFS) increases by more than 5% YoY, it signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY > 3% and RSAFS YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS QoQ > 0.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
